column1: # Supplementary round promoted to main-campaign rigour, 2026-08-12.
# The original round (cells-r5r6-round.tsv) was a single 2-minute run per cell on a
# regenerated seed and different VM resources, which is why Section 4.11 could not be
# merged with the main campaign and why its abstract-level claim rests on the weakest
# design in the paper. This file is the same cell set at 5 minutes with three repeats,
# measured on the 6 CPU / 8 GB configuration and the current seed, so the CV gate
# applies and within-cell variance can be estimated.
# --- same-seed reference cells (default app env), N=100 ---
# --- R6 default-arm JDBC controls (pair partners), N=100 ---
# --- R5 arm: lazy + default_batch_fetch_size=100 (the real S3), N=100 all 5 RTT ---
# --- R5 arm: lazy + bf100 at N=1000 (batch splitting regime: ~800 distinct refs -> ~9 IN queries) ---
# --- R5 arm: lazy + bf1000 at N=1000 (single-batch regime) ---
# --- R6 tuned arm: hikari autoCommit=false + provider_disables_autocommit=true, N=100 ---
